hits.text:
The AI layoff gamble is backfiring.

Companies that rushed to replace workers with AI are now cleaning up the mess, per The Guardian.

Meta scaled back plans to cut staff and use more AI agents after employees spent growing time cleaning up the agents’ technical and security
hits.draft_en:
Companies that rushed to replace workers with AI are now cleaning up the mess, per The Guardian. Meta scaled back its own plan.

AI was never best used as a layoff tool. It's best used by the person who asks it what business fits their skills, gets the plan and launches.
hits.video_tip: Open on the Guardian headline, cut to a screen recording of asking an AI 'what business fits my skills' and the plan it returns; 15s.
hits.why_hit: unusual_whales' AI layoff gamble post was the top watchlist original at 1.29M views (10.6K likes).
